name: Grind Me Fine Coffee House (Specialty Coffee)
address: Shop S20 & - S21 Street 38 - Al Barsha First - Al Barsha - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: GMF Coffee House is a specialty coffee shop in Al Barsha, Dubai, offering carefully crafted coffee and non-coffee beverages alongside freshly prepared breakfast options. Designed for both productivity and relaxation, the café provides a calm, welcoming space for work, meetings, or a quiet break with quality coffee.

reviews.author: Bhavninder Sanghera
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I’ve been coming here every week for the past few months while hosting my fashion community meetups, and it has become one of my favourite creative spaces in Dubai.

The first time I visited was for a content creator event, and I instantly knew it would be the perfect place to bring together fashion lovers, creatives, and entrepreneurs. The atmosphere is cozy, welcoming, and filled with character. Surrounded by beautiful artwork and thoughtful design, it feels more like stepping into a creative friend’s home than a typical café.

A special thank you to Yana for her incredible hospitality and for allowing us to host our Sunday meetups here. She has been so supportive of the community, and our members always tell me how much they love the space.

The drinks are fantastic, and the team behind the counter are always friendly and accommodating. My personal favourites are the taro bubble tea and matcha bubble tea, always with the passion fruit popping pearls.

What I love most is that this venue brings people together. Every Sunday, it becomes a place where creatives connect, share ideas, build friendships, and support one another. Spaces like this are rare, and I’m incredibly grateful to have found it.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for great drinks, genuine hospitality, and a truly inspiring creative atmosphere. 💜🇦🇪

Check out @bhav.xo for more Dubai lifestyle content

reviews.author: George Charles
reviews.text:
What a lovely, quaint little spot tucked away in Barsha!
Such friendly staff! And great to get my iced americano served in a glass, rather than plastic, which so many places seem to do for dine-in service.
Brilliant value menu. We had the low calorie omelette, full English breakfast, and deliciously creamy New York cheesecake.
reviews.owner_reply:
It’s so nice to hear you enjoyed your time with us! We really appreciate you noticing that we serve our iced coffees in glass. It’s a small detail, but we think it makes a big difference.
And we are glad our New York cheesecake hit the spot; it’s definitely one of our favorites! 🍰
Thanks for stopping by, and we look forward to seeing you again soon!

reviews.author: Яна Сахарова
reviews.text:
I’m in love with this soulful space in Dubai 🤍

It’s more than just a coffee place — it’s a place where art, taste, and energy meet. The coffee is truly exceptional, the cookies and food are unforgettable, and every detail feels intentional and alive.

And what makes it even more special are  people behind this space. The owners are incredible, with deep values and a genuine heart, and you can feel it in every corner.
If you’re looking for a place that inspires, nourishes, and fills you with good energy this is it. ✨

Come once… and you’ll want to come back again. ☕️🤍

reviews.author: Aileen Eusebio
reviews.text:
I woke up this morning feeling a little overwhelmed by the amount of work I needed to get done. Instead of staying at home, I decided to spend the day working at my favorite coffee spot in Al Barsha 1, Grind Me Fine Coffee House.
As soon as I opened the door, one of the staff members greeted me warmly, as he always does, and said, "Welcome back." I honestly couldn't remember the last time I had visited because I usually work from home when I don't have much to do. So I was genuinely surprised that he remembered me.
Since my very first visit, I had already noticed him. He consistently treats every customer with respect, kindness, and genuine attentiveness. I had wanted to leave a review for him before, but I never got the chance to ask his name. Today, I finally did.
Thank you, Richard, for your outstanding service. Your warm welcome and positive attitude truly make a difference and are one of the reasons customers keep coming back.
If you're looking for a peaceful place to work, study, or simply unwind over the weekend, I highly recommend Grind Me Fine Coffee House near MD Hotel in Al Barsha 1. They offer a great variety of food and drinks, from sandwiches, ramen, and English breakfast options to excellent hot and cold coffee selections.
The atmosphere is comfortable, the service is exceptional, and the staff genuinely care about their guests. Just like me, I'm sure you'll love it too.
☕️❤️ Highly recommended!
reviews.owner_reply:
Dear Aileen Eusebio,

Thank you very much! It’s wonderful to hear you enjoyed a slow and productive morning with us!

We try our best to make everyone feel at home here, so hearing how Richard welcomed you and turned your morning around is wonderful. I'll make sure to pass your kind words on to him! It will really make his day.

Whether you're working, studying, or just taking a break, we're always happy to have you! Hope to see you back soon! 🙏😊

reviews.author: kamran shaikh
reviews.text: Random find near my hotel turned out to be a very cozy yet amazing cafe. The lavender mojito was very refreshing and super fresh. The chicken croissant sandwich was perfect. Would not change anything!
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you for making us a part of your trip 🥐
We are glad to hear you enjoyed our fresh drinks and food. Thanks for stopping by and we hope to welcome you back whenever you're in the neighborhood!

reviews.author: Aitch Music
reviews.text:
This café is truly a hidden gem, offering excellent service, great prices, and a calm, cozy atmosphere perfect for relaxing or spending long hours. The music and ambiance make it an ideal spot to enjoy your coffee or work on your laptop. Rogers was absolutely amazing—friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better, and Richard and Goan were just as wonderful, providing outstanding service with a warm and welcoming attitude
Appreciate it at all , shout out, deserve over an 1000 stars 👏🏻♥️♥️♥️♥️..

Big time respect 🙏🏻
Kind regards :

Aitch✨

reviews.author: Patch
reviews.text: The place is beautifully filled with art, and the customer service was exceptional from start to finish. We truly enjoyed the ambiance. It's calm, inspiring, and thoughtfully curated. As someone who loves the arts, it felt like the perfect environment to slow down, recharge, and even work on creative projects. If you’re looking for a peaceful spot for quiet time and inspiration, this place is definitely worth visiting.
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you. You described exactly what we try to create here — a space where art, calm, and everyday life meet.

Really glad it resonated with you ✨
You’re always welcome back for another quiet, creative moment.

reviews.author: Oli Rodrigues
reviews.text:
Quaint cafe in Barsha with two absolutely lovely people managing the space. It has an artsy vibe, with just enough daylight showing you around its rustic interior. I had a delicious, homely feel in the English breakfast and thoroughly enjoyed the iced americano. Even the cutlery, the crockery and the serveware has a personal feel to it. It felt like I was treated well at a friend’s home.

(The only downside is that some customers were on zoom calls using headsets that required them to speak loudly for the mic to capture their words.)
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much for such a kind review. We put a lot of love into every detail, so knowing that you felt like you were visiting a friend’s home means a lot to us. 😌🥐

We are also very grateful for your honest feedback regarding the noise levels. It can be disruptive when others are on loud calls, and we’re sorry that it affected your peace. We’ll definitely be more mindful of this to make sure everyone can enjoy our space as they should.

reviews.author: Sally N
reviews.text:
I randomly found this coffee shop near my house while looking for a place to work, and it has now become my go-to spot 🥰🎊

The staff are incredibly friendly and attentive, always welcoming and helpful. Every drink I’ve tried is delicious — the coffee is rich and well-balanced, and even the smallest details like the cups and coasters are beautifully presented.

I especially loved the croissant (I think it’s called zaatar?) — unique and really tasty, definitely worth trying!

They also have a selection of cute souvenirs, and I ended up buying a lovely hat here.

The atmosphere is calm and perfect for working or just relaxing. Highly recommend for coffee lovers! 💛
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much, Sally.
Reading this felt incredibly special for us. We love hearing that Grind Me Fine became your go-to place - especially as a calm corner to work, slow down, and enjoy the atmosphere ☕✨
Your attention to the small details truly means a lot, because we put so much care into every part of the experience - from the coffee itself to the cups, coasters, music, and energy of the space.
And yes, the Zaatar Croissant has become one of our little signatures 🥐💛
Thank you again for your warmth and support. Looking forward to welcoming you back very soon.

reviews.author: Галина Бисарнова
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved this place! ✨

The café is so cozy, charming, and full of character. We had an amazing time here with friends and instantly felt welcome. It’s clear that a lot of love, care, and attention went into creating this space — every little detail adds to the experience.
And the matcha deserves a special shoutout!
Can’t wait to come back. Thank you for such a wonderful experience! 💚☕️
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much for this beautiful review!
Reading words like these reminds us why we created Grind Me Fine in the first place. We wanted to build more than a coffee shop - a place where people can slow down, connect, and feel at home.
We're especially happy that you enjoyed the atmosphere and our matcha 💚 So much love and care goes into every detail, and it means the world to know that it was felt and appreciated.
See you again soon! ☕🌿

reviews.author: Svetlana Ashtaeva
reviews.text: I love this place and keep coming back again and again for its warmth, sincerity, and the energy that surrounds you like the comfort of a mother’s home. I’m very happy to have met and gotten to know the founders. I truly enjoy the cozy atmosphere here and recommend it to all my friends
reviews.owner_reply:
It means a lot to us to hear that Grind Me Fine feels like a home away from home for you!
Building that warmth and sincerity is everything we hoped for when starting this place, and getting to know guests like you is the best part of the journey🙏
Thank you for the heartfelt words and for sharing us with your friends. We can't wait to welcome you back for another cozy visit soon!😌☕

reviews.author: elizalde baron
reviews.text:
I am currently here, and I must say the overall experience has been very pleasant. The staff are extremely friendly, welcoming, and always ready to assist, which immediately creates a warm and comfortable atmosphere. Their positive attitude and professionalism truly enhance the guest experience.
I was pleasantly surprised by the coconut coffee, which was completely new to me. The flavor was rich, smooth, and perfectly balanced, making it a truly enjoyable and memorable drink. It was a unique experience that stood out and added a special touch to my stay.
Additionally, the chocolate cookie chip  treat was beautifully presented. The attention to detail in the presentation reflected care and thoughtfulness, making it feel special rather than ordinary. Small gestures like this leave a lasting impression and show the team’s commitment to quality and guest satisfaction.

reviews.author: Alexander Kadyrov
reviews.text:
Yesterday we met Yana, the owner of GMF Coffee House in Al Barsha — and it was awesome!

It’s such a cozy, atmospheric spot where great coffee meets a warm vibe, a homey feeling, and a touch of art. Definitely recommend everyone to check it out.

Three hours flew by so fast we only realized it was already late evening. We talked about coffee, business, art, Italy, shared insights — it all felt super easy and comfortable.

What really stood out were the nuts, the wafer rolls with condensed milk, some quirky chocolate candies, and the coconut V60 😁

reviews.author: Casey
reviews.text: We love their coffee and san sebastian cake! Even the banana shake is really good. Very nice staff, approachable and pleasant to talk to. If you are a real coffee lover, youll love here. way better than the coffee shop chains out there. This is our go to coffee shop in barsha. 🥰
reviews.owner_reply:
What an amazing review, thank you! We pour our heart into offering something truly special and personal compared to the big chains so your feedback means everything to us
We’re glad you loved the coffee, the San Sebastian cake and our friendly crew 🍰🍦
The team can’t wait to see you back at the bar soon!

reviews.author: kysia tadlip
reviews.text: I absolutely love this place and the vibes here! It feels so peaceful, and every corner is full of art and creativity. I already know I’ll be coming back again and again  I think I just found my new favorite hangout spot. ✨
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you! Some places you visit once… some become yours.
See you again very soon.

reviews.author: WALLTEX
reviews.text: The Barista is so nice & friendly. They don’t just make coffees, they make our day! Love being here everyday. I have not experienced any better cafe around.
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you very much!
That truly means the world to us. Hearing that our team makes your day and that you love coming in everyday is the best compliment we could ever ask for. We can't wait to welcome you back again! 😊🙏

reviews.author: Erika Dela Cruz
reviews.text: Great coffee shop with friendly staff who welcomed us with warm smiles ✨ The place is quiet, cozy, and perfect for relaxing and enjoying a good matcha latte. Definitely a spot I’d visit again. ☕😊
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you for stopping by! Glad you found our space cozy and quiet.
It is great to hear you enjoyed our matcha latte. See you next time! 🍵🌿

reviews.author: Dally Love Jabon
reviews.text: This is a good place to study or eat. I always order the hot chocolate. It is taste better than other hot chocolate in other stores. Also tried the vegetable cheese and liked it. The croissant complemented the fillings.
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much!
We love that the hot chocolate became your go-to - that says a lot.
We’ll be waiting for your next visit.

reviews.author: Ysa Riv
reviews.text: Nice little cafe that i stumbled upon when i was looking for a place to escape the heat and have coffee (got an iced spanish and it was really good and reasonably priced). It is quiet perfect spot for people who are looking for a plce to work. The staff was super nice. I will be back here soon
reviews.owner_reply:
It’s wonderful to know our cafe served as a refreshing stop to beat the heat and get some work done😊
Our staff truly appreciates your compliments🙏
We look forward to serving you another iced Spanish latte on your next visit!

reviews.author: Hanadi B
reviews.text:
Its my second time here , ive tried their lavender lattte (alternative milk cold) my favorite!!!
Second time they have made me an off menu flavor mango latte (almond milk cold) its lovely ! Thank you its sad the location is so hidden needs more recognition. Thank you please dont remove the lavender its my favorite and hard to find!
reviews.owner_reply:
It’s great to have you back for your second visit! We’re glad you love the lavender latte—it’s a favorite here, too, so it’s definitely not going anywhere. And we are happy we could make that custom mango latte for you, it’s always fun to get a little creative with our drinks🪻🥭
We can’t wait to see you again soon for another cozy coffee!

reviews.author: Lukman Pervez
reviews.text:
Nice place to have a coffee,
Very nice and accommodating staffs.
They do try to provide their best.
Greets us with a smile and ask about our preferences.
Had some coffee and avacado toast for breakfast.
reviews.owner_reply: Thanks for the great review! We are glad you enjoyed the coffee and avocado toast and that our team took good care of you. Hope to see you again soon! 🥑☕

reviews.author: Evgeniia Shunkevich
reviews.text: Amazing coffee, breakfast, atmosphere, service! My favourite  place to come on Sunday morning and start the day from the best possible vibes!
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much for this beautiful review.
Reading this truly made our day. We’re so happy that Grind Me Fine became part of your Sunday ritual — exactly the kind of slow, warm mornings we dreamt of creating ☕✨
Amazing guests like you are what give this place its energy. Looking forward to welcoming you again for more coffee, breakfast, and good vibes very soon 💫

reviews.text:
Amazing!!!
We had paint evening, with girls just sit together drinking coffee and painting. It’s amazing amazing amazing. This opportunity to paint, long time dream about it. And also food so good! So that was so good. Thank you so much🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼

reviews.author: Isabel Luzon
reviews.text: This place is cozy and food was delicious we enjoyed our date here.
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you! We're happy to hear you had a wonderful time with us and enjoyed the food.
We hope to welcome you back for many more cozy moments at Grind Me Fine!☕💐

reviews.author: Karly Sidman
reviews.text: Amazing breakfast and amazing coffee!! The service is great and they have games to play while you wait or sip coffee.
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much! 😊
We are happy to hear you enjoyed your breakfast along with the games! Hope to see you back for another round soon! 🥐♟️

reviews.author: Diana Rose Mendoza
reviews.text: Staffs are nice and humble. I like the Iced coffee I ordered Hazelnut latte and it was the best coffee I had for the day. I like the ambiance I feel so relaxed 💯!! The service is 10/10 👌🏻
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much, Diana, for your kind words and for taking the time to share your experience with us!
Your review means a lot to our team, especially as it became our 500th Google review milestone! We are truly grateful for your support.
As a small surprise and a token of our appreciation, we'd love to invite you back for a special treat from us☕✨
Please feel free to ask for Yana on your next visit.
We look forward to welcoming you again soon!

reviews.author: Ann Mugambi
reviews.text:
The place - A small concept café, but very nice. Cozy atmosphere and a pleasant place to relax or work. Quiet.

The staff - warm, soulful

Be sure to ask for Richard & Joan

Prices - reasonable

reviews.author: Ryan Del Pilar
reviews.text: Finally found a relaxing place to be productive and enjoy the ambience. Very accomodating and fast service,
reviews.owner_reply:
We love that our space provides that calm environment you’re looking for.
We look forward to seeing you again soon! 🥐

reviews.author: Alsu Aus-Dubai
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this coffee house, the ambiance and the level of details , food and the service are amazing ! Thanks alot
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much, Alsu. Your words truly mean a lot to us. We put so much love into every detail of the space, atmosphere, food, and guest experience, so reading this makes us genuinely happy ☕✨
Thank you again for your warmth and support — we’ll be very happy to welcome you back to Grind Me Fine soon.
